item.title: Albanese discusses NSW gun buyback scheme
item.description:
Prime Minister Anthony Albanese discussed the New South Wales gun buyback scheme alongside Premier Chris Minns. He noted that current firearm numbers exceed those during the Port Arthur era and emphasized supporting citizens with cost of living relief.

item.title: USA: Democrate cambiano calendario primarie puntando sull'elettorato nero
item.description:

item.title: Mary Peltola rejects Kamala Harris's unsolicited fundraising support
item.description:
